messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty page fired for hadronai-prod reserved-capacity pool hadronai-prod-reserved-01 — symptom=high-latency+throttles, metric=reserved_pool_p95_latency 620ms, throttle_count=27, queue_depth=140. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1718654321 runbook: https://wiki.redwood/runbooks/reserved-pool-throttle

pagerduty: Incident created: PD-89432 assigned to eng-oncall. Urgency: high. Escalation: after ack -> tier2 oncall.

sara (oncall): acked the page. I'm on it. Initial check: cluster reports 92% GPU saturation + burst queue growth. Not seeing immediate pod crashes.

mike (eng-runtime): grabbing logs now. Any tenant-level overrides?

javier (sre): seeing repeated "429 reserved pool throttled" in the gateway logs for /v1/generate for hadronai-prod. Errors started ~1718654200. Also noticing KV cache evictions increased ~30%.

emily (acct-success): Emily from Customer Success here — HadronAI on-call just pinged us. They report slow responses (>10s) in their product and ~5% 502s. Need an ETA to share.

sara (oncall): noted, will update. Hypothesis: reserved pool underprovisioned for a long tail burst (batch sizes increased by tenant). Trying soft-scale.

mike (eng-runtime): running dry-run scale command:
```
redwoodctl scale-pool --pool hadronai-prod-reserved-01 --replicas 4 --cpu 0.8 --gpus 8
```
Will apply if autoscaler won't catch it in 60s.

deploy-bot: Autoscaler attempted a scale at 1718654460 -> failed due to quota error: customer_limit_exceeded.

javier (sre): confirmed: quota cap hit for reserved pools in us-west-2 for hadronai account. That's the blocker.

ana (prod): pinging sales/acct-ops to request temporary quota bump and emergency burst from shared capacity. @emily can you escalate with customer ops?

emily (acct-success): on it. Opening support ticket and requesting emergency burst. CC'ing account-ops. Sharing contact: hadronai-sre@hadronai.com.

sara (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) temporarily route low-priority requests to hosted fallback model variant (model=redwood-small) via routing policy; 2) attempt emergency quota bump; 3) after bump, scale reserved pool. Starting step 1 now.

mike (eng-runtime): routing change applied:
```json
{"policy":"tenant:hadronai","match":"model:large","action":"fallback: redwood-small","duration":"30m"}
```
Result: downstream queue depth dropping from 140 -> 60 in last 90s. Latency p95 trending down to 370ms.

javier (sre): adding short-term KV cache TTL increase to reduce cache churn:
```
redwoodctl kvcache set-ttl --tenant hadronai --ttl 1800
```
Applied. Cache hit ratio up ~12%.

pagerduty: ack recorded by sara (oncall) at 1718654345. Escalation cancelled for now.

emily (acct-success): customer ops confirmed they saw the routing change, reported immediate improvement in UI. They still want timeline for full capacity restoration.

sara (oncall): contacting infra-quota team for emergency bump request: request id Q-7712. Waiting on approval. If approved, will run scale command.

mike (eng-runtime): when quota approved, plan to run:
```
redwoodctl scale-pool hadronai-prod-reserved-01 --replicas 6 --force --wait 300
```
and then revert fallback policy.

javier (sre): monitoring errors — 502 rate down to 0.8% from 5% after routing change. Latency p95 now 220-350ms depending on model mix. Good.

ana (prod): quota team responded: can grant temporary bump to 6 replicas but need approval from finance for overage. Eng can proceed with a 15-minute window while finance approves.

emily (acct-success): told HadronAI we expect to restore full capacity in ~15-25m if bump approved. They're OK with that window.

sara (oncall): proceeding with manual scale under the emergency window. Executing now.

mike (eng-runtime): scale command in progress. Logs: creating 2 new worker pods, attaching GPUs.

deploy-bot: New nodes provisioned at 1718654860. Runtime reports new pool capacity available.

sara (oncall): scaled to 6 replicas. Verifying traffic shift back to reserved pool.

javier (sre): reserved pool accepting traffic. queue_depth -> 12. throttle_count -> 1. p95 latency -> ~180ms.

emily (acct-success): passing update to customer: full service restored to expected latency. Customer asks for post-mortem and preventative action.

sara (oncall): immediate post-incident actions: 1) document incident timeline; 2) request persistent quota increase or autoscaler policy tweak for hadronai; 3) review tenant batching policy to prevent long-tail bursts; 4) add runbook step to auto-failover to hosted fallback earlier.

mike (eng-runtime): opened follow-up ticket INF-4021 for autoscaler+quota automation and INF-4022 for tenant batching guardrails.

javier (sre): leaving monitoring for next 60m. Will handoff to morning oncall at 1718655123.

sara (oncall): handing off to matt (next oncall) with summary: reserved-pool throttle due to quota limit + unexpected tenant burst; mitigated via fallback routing + emergency scale; customer impacted with transient 502s and high latency; tickets created.

matt (oncall): acked handoff. Thanks team.

emily (acct-success): thanks all — I'll coordinate customer postmortem and share notes with HadronAI. :thumbsup:
